story_start.name: Joestar Gang (migrated mid-play)
story_start.description: The Joestar Gang campaign was started in a different Voyage world (Chikara Tokyo with Kobuncho) and migrated from riggedrealm/voyage-memory at t480. The original story start (the brothers register at Chikara Academy) is long past. The Voyage world export is not stored in this repo.

time.calendar: Day counter restarts at 1 on the migration day (t480). The Voyage engine's own day counter conflicted (Day 2 vs Day 8/9) and was never tracked by the director; weekday and clock were set at migration and should be corrected from Voyage's date at the first turn.

narrator_style: Voyage default is warm cel-shaded school slice-of-life; this campaign wants Lookism-style crews plus JoJo-style powers in a crime and vigilante register. State the darker register in Tone: when a scene is dark. Short punchy NPC dialogue, rendered fights.
